## PIPELINE 1: Phishing & Attachment Analysis
`Gmail -> IOC extraction -> URLScan + VirusTotal -> attachment SHA256 -> VirusTotal + MalwareBazaar -> Gemini -> HTML report`

Credentials: Gmail OAuth2 (trigger + send), URLScan, VirusTotal, abuse.ch (Header Auth `Auth-Key`), Google Gemini (PaLM)

## PIPELINE 2: Wazuh Alert Triage
`Wazuh webhook -> normalize + dedupe -> URL / IP / Hash enrichment -> Gemini -> email (true positive) or log (false positive)`

Webhook: POST /webhook/wazuh-alert. Credentials: URLScan, VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB (Header Auth `Key`), abuse.ch (Header Auth `Auth-Key`), Gemini, Gmail.

### AI TRIAGE & RESPONSE
Gemini verdict + rule guard rails (EICAR aware)
